title: Orbuccino
tagline: Orbuccino is the easiest way to support creators and anyone on the world
description:
Orbuccino recreates popular buymeacoffee type of platform on world
- Supporting with 0 fees compared to typical 5-10% of web2 platforms
- Leveraging onchain global payments that are instant and go directly to creators without middlemen

Optimized for user experience
- Search anyone on the world by username
- Featured creators (by region soon?)
- No confusing extra features

Next steps
- Notifications (soon)
- Private messages for supporters for gated communities and private updates (soon)
how_its_made:
Used basic world mini app boilerplate that I copied from my other repository where I was testing if it's working or not without adding anything on top of it. 

Using world documentation, on top a mini kit and with SDK for:
- Login
- Verification level check
- Haptic feedback
- Send onchain transactions

With the help of claude code and burned dozens of $ in credits
- Vercel for deployment
- Neon for database
- Figma for design
